newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh BNP opposition wins by-election.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh BNP opposition wins by-election.

text.p: The main opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) kept its parliamentary seat in a by-election for Manikganj north of Dhaka, election commission officials said on Tuesday.
The election was held on Monday for the vacant seat after BNP legislator Nazimuddin Khan died in April.

The officials said the unofficial result announced late Monday night gave BNP candidate Abdul Wahab Khan the victory in a closely fought poll. Khan polled 59,374 votes against the 52,794 by Abdul Malek of the ruling Awami League.
Manikganj is a traditional stronghold of former prime minister Begum Khaleda Zia's BNP, which lost to the Awami League of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina in the June 1996 general election.
